extension.description: Write maths the way they come to you: keyboard notation → clean inline LaTeX, with a formula preview at the caret.
command.popup.title: MathCursor: popup at caret
command.convert.title: MathCursor: LaTeX completion (Ctrl+Space)
config.culture.description: Math convention: fr (decimal comma, () matrices) or us (decimal point, [] matrices).
config.delimiters.description: Delimiters added around the inserted LaTeX.
config.delimiters.auto: Contextual: formula alone on its line → centered display ($$…$$ in Markdown, \[…\] in LaTeX); otherwise inline $…$
config.maxCandidates.description: Maximum number of candidates proposed (like the Word popup).
config.autoDetect.description: Automatically propose LaTeX conversion as you type (math zone detected at the caret).
config.autoPackages.description: Automatically add \usepackage{amsmath}/{amssymb} to the LaTeX preamble when an inserted formula needs it (\mathbb, matrices, cases…).
config.showLatexInPopup.description: Show the LaTeX source (small, on the right) under each rendered formula in the popup.
config.inlineDisplaystyle.description: When to render inline math at full size (\displaystyle).
config.inlineDisplaystyle.auto: Full size (\displaystyle) inline ONLY when useful (fractions, sums, integrals, lim, binom); otherwise clean textstyle
